LAREDO, Texas — One person was booked into the Webb County Jail on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, on a misdemeanor charge, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search.

JOSE GUADALUPE CASTILLO — Castillo was arrested at 12:47 p.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of driving while intoxicated. Bond was set at $1,500. He is also being held on an out-of-county/state hold. The booking record listed the city as Mexico.

All charges are allegations. Each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
